newsitem.title: FRANCE: France welcomes Serbia parliament decision.
newsitem.headline: France welcomes Serbia parliament decision.

text.p: France on Wednesday welcomed the Serbian parliament's decision to reinstate opposition election victories and said the road now appeared opened for a dialogue between the government and the opposition.
"This is an important step in the right direction. The law has been voted, now it must be applied," Foreign Ministry spokesman Yves Doutriaux told reporters.

"The road now seems open for a true dialogue between the government and the opposition. This is a dialogue that France has always encouraged and which it is naturally ready to back, including in a European framework," he said.
Serbian opposition leaders visited Paris last week where they were received by Foreign Minister Foreign Minister Herve de Charette, who encouraged their action.
